rules: First threshold and half-threshold release, more protection at 20% until below 10%. Numbers in grid are first trigger, first and deep consensus share, target cap while active. Use previous-close Ridge shadow equity, during existing fallback only, next open.
selection: Lock the lowest 2023-24 drawdown among variants whose early daily equity and trades exactly reproduce old20 and whose 2023-24 net and double-fee return are no lower than old20. Tie: prefer higher net return. Verify 2025, combined period, coursework and forward after lock.
midpoint_check: The 87.5% cap is a follow-up sensitivity added after seeing the original cap endpoints. It is excluded from the initial guard selection.
followup: Two more exploratory alternatives aim to reduce jump concentration: add at most 50 percentage points to target exposure per session, or cap exposure at trailing 252-session volatility divided by 20-session volatility. Apply only while protection is enabled.
concentration_check: Check the 87.5% midpoint across all three depths. Among all rules that match early weights, preserve 2023-24 returns at standard and double fees, and reduce drawdown, choose the smallest drawdown with no increase in maximum rolling two-session gain.
post_hoc: All windows previously viewed. The 18% threshold showed promise in the previous sensitivity run. The return audit uses no alteration of actual returns. Removing extreme days is attribution only.
